name: agnostic-simulator-runtime-subset
description: LOCAL FILE (not upstream): installs the runtime dependencies of the vendored agnostic-simulator packages (bot-core, engine-core, protocol, card-model) that the One Piece engine imports, and links the @tcg/* packages that the vendored browser UI (simulator-ui, simulator-contract, simulator-runtime and apps/multi-game-simulator/src/games/one-piece) imports (and the shared tsconfig their tsconfig.json files extend, which the bundler reads). The UI's third-party dependencies (React, Mantine...) are packages/web dependencies, hoisted to the repository root by the root pnpm-workspace.yaml.
